member.name: T:ContextCompiler.Reports.Modules.Pipelines.Mermaid.MermaidDiagramOptions
member.summary: Configuration options for Mermaid diagram generation.

member.name: P:ContextCompiler.Reports.Modules.Pipelines.Mermaid.MermaidDiagramOptions.MaxTextSize
member.summary: Gets or sets the maximum text size allowed in the Mermaid diagram. Default is 200000 characters.

member.name: P:ContextCompiler.Reports.Modules.Pipelines.Mermaid.MermaidDiagramOptions.MaxEdges
member.summary: Gets or sets the maximum number of edges in the diagram. Default is 2000.

member.name: P:ContextCompiler.Reports.Modules.Pipelines.Mermaid.MermaidDiagramOptions.DetailLevel
member.summary: Gets or sets the detail level for the diagram. Default is Detailed to show all events including items.

member.name: P:ContextCompiler.Reports.Modules.Pipelines.Mermaid.MermaidDiagramOptions.ShowModuleDetails
member.summary: Gets or sets whether to show module details in phase nodes. Default is true.

member.name: P:ContextCompiler.Reports.Modules.Pipelines.Mermaid.MermaidDiagramOptions.ShowDuration
member.summary: Gets or sets whether to show duration information in phase nodes. Default is true.

member.name: P:ContextCompiler.Reports.Modules.Pipelines.Mermaid.MermaidDiagramOptions.ShowItemIds
member.summary: Gets or sets whether to show item IDs in the diagram. Default is true.

member.name: T:ContextCompiler.Reports.Modules.Pipelines.Mermaid.DiagramDetailLevel
member.summary: Defines the level of detail for the diagram.

member.name: F:ContextCompiler.Reports.Modules.Pipelines.Mermaid.DiagramDetailLevel.Condensed
member.summary: Groups all events by phase, showing only phase-level information. Most compact view.

member.name: F:ContextCompiler.Reports.Modules.Pipelines.Mermaid.DiagramDetailLevel.Detailed
member.summary: Shows individual events with module and item information. Full detail view.
